answers.q2: The function is `unescapeHtml`. It is exported as `module.exports.unescape = unescapeHtml`, so `module.exports` is still `escapeHtml`.
answers.q3: `'` has no named case. It goes through the decimal numeric path: parseInt base 10, then `String.fromCharCode(39)`.

answers.q5: It builds a surrogate pair manually: 0xD800+(cp>>10) and 0xDC00+(cp&0x3FF). For `😀` that gives `\uD83D\uDE00`.
answers.q6: It asserts that single-layer decoding happens, so `&lt;` becomes `<` rather than `<`. The exact test code is not shown.
